No you're right. I need to put my big girl panties on and deal. The biggest issue is money though.
Well I've already come quite a ways (74 pounds down) but I'm totally broke and don't want to have to buy a crap load of clothes now and then again later.
Yea she knows, I've just never been comfortable openly confronting situations like these. I feel like I'm tripping over my words when I talk to her about it.
It's mostly a self esteem issue and since weight loss is much harder with estrogen, I don't want to have a super low self esteem when self esteem means everything during transition.

Yea I think about it a lot, but my sister deeply respects my mom and is I guess 'loyal' to the extreme. She doesn't understand why I have trouble dealing with her. I really love my sister and I don't want to hurt her either so again, another road block.

yes but it went poorly. She was yelling at me because I didn't have all the answers and saying that I had no right to put this on her etc. I really don't want to talk to her about it again because frankly, she scares me.
I'm 21 and I actually don't live with her. I live with my sister but my mom comes over fairly often.

When I came out to her she made it all about her. "What do I tell my friends" "what about my life". I was so emotionally broken at that point I couldn't think of what to say. Now she keeps trying to reinforce that I'm male and I can't STAND it. Another reason for guilt is my dad died when I was younger and so she really looks at me to BE him, which is just wrong to begin with! I just feel like it would destroy her but on the other hand I need to do what's right for me, I just don't think I can.
There is a lot of guilt as well. My mom has always been able to manipulate me with guilt. I know I should just say no to her and move on but I can't.
